item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary of the Interior to manage BLM lands according to broad stewardship, participation, investment, and conflict-resolution principles; any legal consequences would arise later through discretionary land-management decisions.","evidence":"directing you to manage the public lands administered by BLM in accordance with the following principles"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary to establish an internal BLM planning process for developing, evaluating, and coordinating program alternatives, without dictating a legally consequential outcome.","evidence":"directing you to improve BLM's overall planning process by establishing a \"program development process\" for BLM"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President prescribes analytical and descriptive requirements for BLM's future program alternatives; the segment governs internal planning and does not itself alter legal rights or require a specified later legal consequence.","evidence":"I am directing that each of the alternative programs developed by BLM shall"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary to prioritize protection of nationally significant BLM resources, leaving the particular protective actions and any later legal consequences unspecified.","evidence":"directing you to give special attention to protecting areas of BLM-administered lands"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The Department must develop a process and criteria for identifying resources and proposing protections by a deadline; this is planning work, and any protective legal consequence would require a later decision.","evidence":"the Department shall develop by June 1980 a process and criteria"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretaries of Agriculture and the Interior to prepare coordination objectives, a process, and a timetable; the listed matters are subjects for consideration rather than dictated legal outcomes.","evidence":"I am directing you to develop within six months a detailed statement of coordination objectives and a process and timetable for achieving them"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the two departments to cooperate on assessment and compatible planning and to submit legislative recommendations; these are coordination, planning, and reporting functions without a present or prescribed later legal consequence.","evidence":"both of your Departments should cooperate fully in the preparation of the National Assessment of Renewable Resources"}]}
